## Checklist
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Tried in the browser (display and admin where relevant)
- [ ] Player-facing text is Czech; code, comments and commits are English
- [ ] No new dependencies (or an approved vendored file with `NOTICE.txt`)
- [ ] State that must survive a restart is in `serialize()` and `parseSavedState()`
- [ ] README / AGENTS.md / screenshots updated if needed
